2610.08892.title: Hybrid++: The Bridge between PDE Models and Deep Learning for Gamma Noise Removal
2610.08892.paper_summary: Multiplicative gamma noise is one of the dominant noise factors in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and medical ultrasound images. They are dependent on pixel level noises due to which they are highly varying across the image and harder to handle as compared to additive noise. The denoising methods to address this noise currently include classical partial differential equation (PDE) methods which are good for interpretation but lack the restoration ability as compared to the state-of-the-art models while deep convolutional networks like DnCNN achieve high performance but at the cost of transparency due to which practitioners are skeptical to use them in high-risk critical fields like medicine. This paper presents Hybrid++, a novel trainable nonlinear reaction-diffusion architecture that addresses both the concerns - staying interpretable while offering performance close to huge black-box models. It combines a fully learnable PDE initialization with a 3-stage reaction-diffusion network having 64-channel multiscale filter banks, 4-layer Squeeze-and-Excitation attention-based influence functions and a 64-dimensional noise level embedding. It uses a two-phase training strategy, stage-wise optimization followed by joint end-to-end refinement which enables co-adaptation of all learnable parameters. On the FoE benchmark, Hybrid++ substantially improves over classical PDE, BM3D and the original TNRD baselines. In the severe-noise setting L=1, it comes within 0.23 dB PSNR of a separately trained DnCNN while using only about 8% of its parameters. We therefore position Hybrid++ not as a universal state-of-the-art image restoration backbone, but as a compact, physically structured reaction-diffusion model for multiplicative gamma noise.
2610.08892.paper_summary_zh: 乘法伽瑪噪聲是合成孔徑雷達（SAR）和醫療超聲影像中主要的噪聲因素之一。它們依賴於像素級的噪聲，因此在影像中變化很大，相較於加性噪聲更難處理。目前針對這種噪聲的去噪方法包括經典的偏微分方程（PDE）方法，這些方法在解釋上表現良好，但相較於最先進的模型缺乏恢復能力，而像DnCNN這樣的深度卷積網絡則在性能上表現優異，但在透明度上有所妥協，因此實務工作者對其在高風險的關鍵領域如醫學中的使用持懷疑態度。本文提出了Hybrid++，一種新穎的可訓練非線性反應擴散架構，旨在解決這兩個問題——在保持可解釋性的同時，提供接近大型黑箱模型的性能。它結合了一個完全可學習的PDE初始化與一個具有64通道多尺度濾波器組、4層壓縮與激勵注意力基於影響函數的3階段反應擴散網絡，以及一個64維的噪聲水平嵌入。它使用兩階段的訓練策略，階段優化後進行聯合端到端的精煉，這使得所有可學習參數能夠共同適應。在FoE基準上，Hybrid++在經典PDE、BM3D和原始TNRD基準上有了顯著改善。在嚴重噪聲設置L=1下，它的PSNR僅比單獨訓練的DnCNN低0.23 dB，同時僅使用約8%的參數。因此，我們將Hybrid++定位為一種緊湊的、物理結構化的乘法伽瑪噪聲反應擴散模型，而非通用的最先進影像恢復骨幹。
